{{Quote|I let everyone on our planet down! I'm going to make up for it!|Kiros Zorad|<ref name="live" />}}
'''Kiros Zorad''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Arda II]] who by [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] found himself heavily in debt to local businessman and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]] [[Mag Doum]]. Doum ordered Zorad and his son [[Zon Zorad|Zon]] to kidnap visiting [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] when she and her compatriot [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] appeared to threaten Doum's side business selling discarded [[T-6 diodem]]s to the Imperials. Zorad and his son, who actually intended to protect Organa, broke into the [[Qualo Estate|estate]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] ruling [[Qualo]] and [[Stun baton/Legends|stunned]] Organa before fleeing on a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]].<ref name="live" />

After a lengthy chase, Zorad left Zon and Organa at the nearby [[Caverns of Colla-Di]] before joining forces with Skywalker. Zorad and Skywalker returned to the caverns to find nothing but [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] rags, leading Zorad to believe his son and Organa were [[Death/Legends|dead]]&mdash;after fighting off a vicious [[kdak]], Zorad stole Skywalker's [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and returned to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tun Wala]], where he exposed Doum's treachery and caused a near-riot. Realizing that Doum would flee and inform the Empire of the Rebels' presence on Arda II, Zorad stowed away on Doum's [[Starship/Legends|ship]] as he left the planet, attack and hijacking the vessel as he passed a message to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. When Vader's [[Fleet/Legends|battle group]] arrived above Arda II, Zorad severely damaged the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord's]] [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] with a suicide run in Doum's ship, forcing the Empire's [[Attack on Arda II|retreat]].<ref name="live" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kiros Zorad appeared in the [[Star Wars (comic strip)|comic strip]] story arc ''[[As Long As We Live...]]'', written by [[Don Christensen]] and released in [[1980]]. In the comic, Zorad was illustrated by [[Russ Manning]].<ref name="live" />
